mapping_effect: New local candidate registry under the unresolved source identity, derived from exact linked source meanings; not a recovered source registry or operational admission.

obligations.statement: Every mutating participant command verifies the exact canonical message against that Knowledge Identity's registered wallet key.
Plaintext, content keys, wallet secrets and encryption private keys never enter the service API or persisted state.
Ciphertext and every recipient envelope must match their declared SHA-256 byte identity before persistence.
Preparing a grant does not add the recipient, advance revision or permit recipient retrieval.
A grant or reissue becomes active only after a matching transaction is independently observed as finalized on Solana Devnet.
Grant activation adds B without removing A or any other current owner.
An access response contains only the authenticated current owner's active envelope.
Reissue changes only B's binding and envelope plus revision; owners, artifact version, policy and epoch stay fixed.
All hosted grants have zero knowledge consideration; network and hosting costs remain separate observations.
Logical SQL layers are not claimed as independent backups; VPS readiness requires a verified off-host encrypted archive restore.
